statement.zh: **标准**：国密浏览器接口（Chinese Cryptography Browser Interface）。
statement.en: **Standard**: Chinese Cryptography Browser Interface (国密浏览器接口).GM/T 0087 defines a Chinese cryptography browser interface exposing SM2/SM3/SM4 operations and certificate handling.
